nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every 6 hours. Adjust interval in .env SCHEDULE_HOURS

nodes.name: Run Trend Discovery
nodes.notes: Runs trend discovery and topic ranking. Returns scored topics.

nodes.name: Topic Found?
nodes.notes: Checks if a valid topic was discovered. Stops run if nothing found.

nodes.name: Run Full Pipeline
nodes.notes: Runs the complete pipeline: script → voice → visuals → video → upload

nodes.name: Upload Success?
nodes.notes: Checks if the video was successfully uploaded to YouTube.

nodes.name: Discord Success Alert
nodes.notes: Sends Discord notification on successful upload. Set DISCORD_WEBHOOK in .env

nodes.name: Discord Error Alert
nodes.notes: Sends Discord notification on failure. Review the logs directory.

parameters.command: cd /app && python -c "from src.monitoring.logger import get_pipeline_summary; from src.database import init_db, get_session; s = get_pipeline_summary(get_session(init_db())); import json; print(json.dumps(s, indent=2))"

nodes.name: No Topic - Log Skip
nodes.notes: Logs a skip event when no new topic is available. No action needed.

parameters.command:
cd /app && python -c "
from src.database import init_db, get_session
from src.growth.optimizer import PerformanceTracker
from src.upload.youtube import YouTubeUploader
db = get_session(init_db())
tracker = PerformanceTracker()
uploader = YouTubeUploader()
updated = tracker.fetch_and_save(db, uploader)
print(f'Updated analytics for {updated} videos')
"

nodes.name: Fetch Analytics (Daily)
nodes.notes: Fetches YouTube analytics once per day for all uploaded videos.

nodes.name: Daily Analytics Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs once per day to pull YouTube performance data.

_setup_instructions.step4: Import this file: Settings → Import workflow → select this JSON
_setup_instructions.step5: Set environment variable DISCORD_WEBHOOK in n8n settings if you want alerts
_setup_instructions.step6: Activate the workflow with the toggle in the top right
_setup_instructions.note: The Execute Command nodes assume /app is your project root. Adjust the path.
